title: Gemini images get an optional reasoning mode
summary:
Optional reasoning for Gemini images, more precise usage windows and exports, and a refreshed community catalog.

The image API added a `reasoning` flag for nanobanana, nanobanana-2, and nanobanana-pro. It defaults to off; enabling it uses Gemini thinking mode for text rendering and layout. Other image models ignore the flag.

Enter’s usage graph now requests the selected 7-, 30-, or 90-day window, and its API-key filter uses exact per-key daily data. Daily Summary exports cover the full selected period; Detailed Usage exports contain the latest 50,000 rows within it. Usage APIs also gained `days` options and stable pagination.

The automated catalog update raised the Greenhouse count from 673 to 678 community apps. A follow-up README update refreshed Latest News and Recent Apps and corrected Polli-com’s author credit.

daily.title: Reasoning for Gemini images
daily.text: Set `reasoning=true` when generating images with `nanobanana`, `nanobanana-2`, or `nanobanana-pro` to use Gemini thinking mode for text rendering and layout. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Choose usage history windows
daily.text: Use the `days` parameter to request up to 90 days of usage history or daily aggregates. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
